entry_sequence.transcript_quote: First, I switch over to the 5-minut chart.
entry_sequence.action: Switch to the 5-minute chart for entry execution while keeping the opening range based on the first 15 minutes.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker uses the faster chart to react to the pullback setup.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I have to use the first three candles to define my range high and range low.
entry_sequence.action: Define the opening range using the first three 5-minute candles, which represent the first 15 minutes of the day.
entry_sequence.rationale: Those three candles establish the ORB high and low.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I then wait for my breakout just like before.
entry_sequence.action: For long, wait for price to break out above the opening range; for short, wait for price to break out below the opening range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The setup begins only after an initial breakout from the opening range.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: I prefer to wait for the candle to actually break through and then close above.
entry_sequence.action: For long, require the breakout candle to close above the range; for short, require it to close below the range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The speaker prefers a closing breakout rather than an intrabar break.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: Instead, should I just place a stop order at the opening range? That way, when price hits it, I get in immediately
entry_sequence.action: After the breakout, wait for price to pull back to the opening range and place a stop order at the range boundary so entry triggers immediately on the retest: buy at the range high for longs or sell at the range low for shorts.
entry_sequence.rationale: This variation enters on the retest instead of waiting for a confirmation high/low break.

stop.transcript_quote: This time, the stop loss is still at the bottom of the range.
stop.rationale: The speaker keeps the stop at the opposite side of the opening range.

targets.rationale: The speaker uses a 1.5 take-profit target for this variation.

confluences.transcript_quote: I then wait for my breakout just like before.
